failure.detail: The fresh runtime qualification passed, but the fixed +1.5 ms canary-anchor mutation produced an affine residual below the frozen 1 ms bound for this independent anchor distribution; 48 of 49 current mutations rejected and the canonical matrix was not started.

rca: A fixed clock-anchor offset is not an invariant mutation for an all-point affine fit because leverage and the independent anchor distribution can absorb a different fraction of that offset. The mutation layer now computes exact-rational OLS metrics and deterministically selects the smallest source-anchor delta that crosses the 1 ms residual bound while preserving the frozen 2 ms step and 100 ppm drift preconditions.
